title: Python Pandas
description: Pandas is used to analyze data. It has functions for analyzing, cleaning, exploring, and manipulating data.
example:
import pandas as pd
dataset = {
  'cars': ["BMW", "Volvo", "Ford"],
  'passings': [3, 7, 2]
}
myvar = pd.DataFrame(dataset)
print(myvar)

challenges.title: Pandas Series
challenges.exercise: Import pandas as pd. Create a simple Pandas Series from a list [1, 7, 2]. Print it.
challenges.solution:
import pandas as pd
a = [1, 7, 2]
myvar = pd.Series(a)
print(myvar)
